MAF repository: PM Copilot and examples. Python 3.10+, PEP 8, `agent-framework==1.0.0rc4`.

python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env  # then fill in OPENAI_API_KEY at minimum
python app.py --console      # Interactive terminal
python app.py --server       # FastAPI server (Teams + local web chat + AG-UI)
python app.py --devui        # MAF Developer UI (visual debugging)
python app.py --copilotkit   # Alias for --server

Endpoints: `POST /api/local_chat`, `POST /api/messages`, `GET /chat`, `/copilotkit`. `GRAPH_MODE=mock` defaults to stub data; `GRAPH_MODE=live` requires Azure credentials.

cd maf_copilotkit/agent
uv venv && source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .
uvicorn server:app --reload --port 8000
cd maf_copilotkit/web
pnpm install && pnpm dev
cd tmp-ag-ui
pnpm install && pnpm build
pnpm test    # run tests
pnpm lint    # lint code
pnpm dev     # watch mode for SDKs

Star-topology handoff: Triage (`maf/agents/triage.py`) routes to SharePoint, Meetings, Calendar, Documents, Project Info; specialists return to Triage. Orchestration: `maf/orchestration/handoff_workflow.py`, `HandoffBuilder`. Tools: `maf/tools/`, `<REDACTED_USER>(approval_mode="never_require")`, `Annotated`; Graph: `maf/tools/graph_client.py`; config: `maf/config.py`; AG-UI: `maf/agui_endpoint.py`. Examples: `maf/agents/01_handoff/` through `05_magentic/`.

New tools go in `maf/tools/`, new agents in `maf/agents/`
New agents in the PM Copilot flow must be wired in `maf/orchestration/handoff_workflow.py`
Never commit `.env` files or secrets
Update `ANTIGRAVITY.md` if architectural changes are made
See `ANTIGRAVITY.md` for MAF upgrade procedures
